# بيت الحكمة (Bayt Al-Hikma) — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Bayt Al-Hikma (House of Wisdom) is a spiritually rich Arabic educational platform founded around the teachings and biography of Maliha Muslimani, focusing on Sufism, Islamic wisdom, and self-knowledge. The platform blends free and premium content — including Sufi chants, spiritual articles, educational videos, PDF books, and private courses — all wrapped in a serene turquoise aesthetic inspired by Islamic geometric art and Mandala motifs. The overarching philosophy is captured in the timeless wisdom: 'He who knows himself knows his Lord.' The platform supports PayPal payments and offers both full subscription access and à-la-carte content purchasing.

### مسارات التعلم

### السماع والعرفان

### التعلم البصري
https://example.com/visual-learning

### المسار الخاص والسيرة
https://example.com/private-path-biography
رحلة حميمية في سيرة مليحة مسلماني وتعاليمها الروحية الفريدة. احصل على فيديوهات حصرية كاملة مجانية الاستخدام وكتب PDF نادرة. ادخل إلى دائرة العارفين الخاصة الآن.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About بيت الحكمة (Bayt Al-Hikma)
Bayt Al-Hikma (House of Wisdom) is a spiritually rich Arabic educational platform founded around the teachings and biography of Maliha Muslimani, focusing on Sufism, Islamic wisdom, and self-knowledge. The platform blends free and premium content — including Sufi chants, spiritual articles, educational videos, PDF books, and private courses — all wrapped in a serene turquoise aesthetic inspired by Islamic geometric art and Mandala motifs. The overarching philosophy is captured in the timeless wisdom: 'He who knows himself knows his Lord.' The platform supports PayPal payments and offers both full subscription access and à-la-carte content purchasing.

## Services/Products
- Paid learning paths (PDF books + audio files)
- Sufi music and chants (partially free, full access via subscription)
- Free spiritual articles (Irfan section)
- Free video content
- Private course booking in Sufism and wisdom
- Biography of Maliha Muslimani
- Contact page
- Subscription model with full or selective content purchase
- PayPal payment support

## Target Audience
- People interested in Sufism, Islamic wisdom, and spiritual self-development
- Sufi Enthusiasts
- Islamic Wisdom Seekers
- Spiritual Self-Developers

## Industry
Online Education & Spiritual Learning
